question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pco.order_id, pco.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_clean_customer_orders pco
    INNER JOIN pizza_clean_runner_orders pro ON pco.order_id = pro.order_id
    WHERE pro.cancellation IS NULL OR pro.cancellation = ''
),
order_base_toppings AS (
    SELECT do2.order_id, do2.pizza_id,
           TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', n)) AS topping_id
    FROM delivered_orders AS do2
    INNER JOIN pizza_recipes AS pr ON do2.pizza_id = pr.pizza_id,
    UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, 12)) AS t(n)
    WHERE TRIM(SPLIT_PART(pr.toppings, ',', n)) != ''
)
SELECT pizza_id, COUNT(*) AS topping_count FROM order_base_toppings GROUP BY pizza_id
